start.title: Your Servant
start.text:
Your servant lies dying.
You hear a teacher is near.

choices.feedback: Luke 7:3 — The centurion sent elders of the Jews to Jesus, asking him to come and heal his servant.

doctor_consequence.title: Seek the Healer
doctor_consequence.text:
No skill of Rome can save him.
Only Jesus can.

wait_consequence.title: Do Not Delay
wait_consequence.text:
Mercy passes through your town.
Reach him now.

seek.title: Before the Teacher
seek.text:
You stand before him.
A Roman among his people.

choices.feedback: Luke 7:4 — The elders of the Jews earnestly pleaded with Jesus on the centurion's behalf, explaining his worthiness.

agree.title: "I Will Come"
agree.text:
"I will come and heal him."
He steps toward your home.

choices.feedback: Luke 7:6 — The centurion sent friends to Jesus, saying he was not worthy for Jesus to come under his roof.

proud_consequence.title: Look Within
proud_consequence.text:
Who are you that he should come?
Speak the truth.

faith.title: Only Say the Word
faith.text:
"I am not worthy."
What will you ask?

choices.feedback: Luke 7:7 — The centurion believed that if Jesus merely spoke a word, his servant would be healed.

hurry_consequence.title: Trust His Word
hurry_consequence.text:
His word alone is enough.
Speak it.

sign_consequence.title: No Proof Needed
sign_consequence.text:
Faith does not bargain.
Speak from belief.

praise.title: Such Great Faith
praise.text:
He turns to the crowd amazed.
"I have not seen such faith."

choices.feedback: Luke 7:9 — Jesus marveled at the centurion's faith and declared that he had not found such great faith, not even in Israel.

boast_consequence.title: Stay Humble
boast_consequence.text:
The glory is not yours.
Bow quietly.

heal.title: Healed From Afar
heal.text:
You return home.
Your servant breathes deep, well.
